# RealIRacing

> RealIRacing (realiracing.com) is an iRacing sim racing site by Carlos Martinez: practical guides on force feedback settings, wheel and pedal buyer's guides, safety rating and racecraft, car and track guides, and OBS streaming setups, plus race highlights, setup guides and rig tours on the @realtape YouTube channel. Real motorsport roots, tested on a real rig.

## About
- Author: Carlos Martinez (iRacing user "Carlos Martinez9"). Home: https://realiracing.com/
- Rig: MOZA R9 direct drive wheelbase, MOZA CS V2 wheel, MOZA SR-P pedals, RTX 5060 Ti, 1440p 120 Hz monitor. Full breakdown: https://realiracing.com/gear.html
- Affiliate disclosure: gear links go to Amazon and carry an affiliate tag; the author may earn a commission at no cost to the reader. The site does not use sponsored loaner hardware.
- 244 blog guides published so far; new posts appear several times a week.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://realiracing.com/): channel overview, content types, gear picks, FAQ
- [Blog](https://realiracing.com/blog/): all iRacing guides, settings and gear advice
- [My Rig](https://realiracing.com/gear.html): every part Carlos races and streams on, with notes on why
- [Link hub](https://realiracing.com/go/): all platforms in one place
- [YouTube @realtape](https://www.youtube.com/@realtape): race highlights, setup guides, rig tours, iRacing tips
- Social: [Instagram @realiracing](https://www.instagram.com/realiracing) · [TikTok @realiracing](https://www.tiktok.com/@realiracing) · [X @realiracing](https://x.com/realiracing)

## Latest blog posts (newest first)

- [Grip pressure and hand position on a direct drive wheel](https://realiracing.com/blog/grip-pressure-hand-position-direct-drive-wheel-iracing.html): Why a death grip hides force feedback detail in iRacing, how to hold a direct drive wheel, and a practice routine to test your own grip pressure.
- [ISDE 2018 in Chile: My Motocross Clips | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/isde-2018-vina-del-mar-chile-final-motocross.html): I filmed the 2018 ISDE in Viña del Mar, Chile: the final motocross on November 17, plus an enduro mass start.
- [Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach 2018: My Fan Footage](https://realiracing.com/blog/long-beach-grand-prix-2018-from-the-grandstand.html): My own clips from the 2018 Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach: IndyCars, Stadium Super Trucks and the Mothers Exotic Car Paddock.
- [Monaco and Cannes Supercar Spotting 2025 | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/monaco-cannes-supercars-summer-2025.html): Phone clips I filmed myself in Monaco and Cannes in summer 2025: a Ferrari F40, Casino Square, a Bugatti Chiron and more.
- [Monsters on the Beach 2011: Virginia Beach Fence Clips](https://realiracing.com/blog/monsters-on-the-beach-2011-virginia-beach-monster-trucks.html): My own fence-side clips from Monsters on the Beach 2011 on the Virginia Beach oceanfront, with Grave Digger and Stone Crusher.
- [I Drove the Nordschleife in Heavy Rain: Golf GTI 2025 | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/nordschleife-in-heavy-rain-golf-gti-back-seat.html): I drove a VW Golf GTI MK7 around the Nürburgring Nordschleife in heavy rain on July 29, 2025. Onboard clips, filmed from inside the car.
- [Rally Chile 2019: My Stage Side Clips | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/rally-chile-2019-stage-side.html): I filmed Rally Chile 2019 on my phone from the side of the stages near Concepción. What happened, and what my clips show.
- [Belgian GP 2025 at Spa: My Grandstand Clips | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/spa-francorchamps-2025-belgian-gp-from-the-grandstand.html): My phone clips from the 2025 F1 Belgian Grand Prix at Spa-Francorchamps, filmed from the grandstand at La Source.
- [2023 YellaWood 500 at Talladega: Filmed From the Stands](https://realiracing.com/blog/talladega-2023-yellawood-500-from-the-grandstand.html): I filmed the 2023 YellaWood 500 at Talladega from the grandstand: the pack, pit road and a 0.012-second photo finish.
- [iRacing Hockenheim: Mazda MX-5 From P20 to P14 | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-hockenheim-mx5-p20-to-p14.html): Clips from my iRacing Mazda MX-5 race at Hockenheim. I started P20 and finished P14. This is a racing simulator, not real life.
- [iRacing at the Nordschleife: Clips From the Ring](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-nordschleife-stream-clips.html): Short iRacing clips from the Nürburgring Nordschleife: starts, GT cars, forest corners and rain, filmed in a racing simulator.
- [iRacing at Okayama: MX-5 and Porsche Clips | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-okayama-mx5-stream-clips.html): Short iRacing clips from Okayama International Circuit in Japan, with Mazda MX-5 race action and laps from a Porsche cockpit.
- [iRacing IMSA Clips at Road Atlanta | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-road-atlanta-imsa-stream-clips.html): Short iRacing clips from Road Atlanta in IMSA multiclass races. This is a racing simulator. See prototypes, Porsches and GT cars in the trees.
- [iRacing Spa-Francorchamps: Rain, Dust and Evening Light](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-spa-francorchamps-stream-clips.html): A gallery of iRacing clips at Spa-Francorchamps. Wet GT3 packs, dust, the long climb and evening light, all in a racing simulator.
- [iRacing Stream Clips: GT Cars, Stock Cars and Rain](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-stream-clips-gt-cars-stock-cars-rain.html): A gallery of short iRacing clips from my streams: GT3 and GT4 packs, stock cars on a banked oval, rain laps and the Red Bull Ring.
- [Redondo Beach Car Show, April 2018: Hot Rods and Corvettes](https://realiracing.com/blog/redondo-beach-car-show-april-2018.html): Phone clips from a car show by the harbor in Redondo Beach, California, April 2018. A rat rod, a Viper, Corvettes, a Chevelle and a sunset.
- [iRacing lag: fix Wi-Fi, warping and connection drops](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-lag-wifi-ethernet-connection-fix.html): Cars warping, sudden teleports or a dropped session in iRacing? How I separate connection problems from PC stutter, and what to fix first on a home network.
- [Braking Markers and Reference Points in iRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/braking-markers-reference-points-iracing.html): How I pick fixed braking markers and corner reference points in iRacing, move them in small steps, and keep them honest as fuel and tyres change.
- [iRacing Safety Rating: How to Climb Out of Rookie](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-safety-rating-license-climb-from-rookie.html): How iRacing's Safety Rating and license classes work, what costs you incident points and the habits that get a new driver out of Rookie without wrecking.
- [Shift Lights and Dash Displays for iRacing: Do You Need One?](https://realiracing.com/blog/shift-lights-and-dash-displays-iracing-do-you-need-one.html): What a shift light bar or dash display actually adds in iRacing, what the sim already shows you for free, and the order I would buy in from a MOZA R9 and CRP2 rig.
